purpose: How many conflict-free schedules fit the available time slots?
meaning: A proper vertex coloring gives labels to vertices so that every adjacent pair has different labels. Here a vertex is a workshop session and its label is a numbered time slot. Count proper assignments for the selected palette; the smallest palette with a proper assignment is the chromatic number.

definition.setting: Four workshop sessions form a cycle of shared-instructor conflicts. An optional extra conflict joins sessions 1 and 3. Every session needs one slot; conflicting sessions must use different slots.
